role: adjudicator: advisory; can add reasons and route to a human, never clears

supported.claim: The analyzer and generator do not crash on duplicate keys.
The analyzer and generator do not crash on duplicate keys or mixed key kinds.
supported.why: Supported by targeted tests for duplicate int/string keys and mixed key kinds passing in tests.targeted.

supported.claim: There is a potential crash site in the code.
supported.why: The verified quote at TypeCollector.cs:985 shows a hard cast to PropertyDeclarationSyntax, which can cause an InvalidCastException if the member is a field or record parameter.

unsupported.claim: The analyzer crashes on [Key(null)] record parameters.
unsupported.why: This claim is based on a probe not included in the verified facts.json.

evidence_that_would_settle: A test case that defines a [MessagePackObject(SuppressSourceGeneration = true)] type with a [Key] attribute on a primary constructor parameter (record) or a field, to verify if the hard cast at TypeCollector.cs:985 causes a crash.
rulings.note: Targeted tests prove fix for some invalid contracts, but a verified hard cast suggests other invalid contracts may still trigger crashes.

supported.claim: The duplicate-key crash was not present on base.
supported.why: Supported by SuppressSourceGenerationAnalyzerTests.DuplicateKeysAreReportedWithoutAnalyzerFailureForGeneratedTypes failing the tests.fail_without_fix check (meaning it passed on base).

unsupported.claim: The regression (analyzer not working for suppressed types) is not on this base.
unsupported.why: Contradicted by SuppressSourceGenerationAnalyzerTests.MemberWithoutKeyIsReported passing the tests.fail_without_fix check, which indicates the analyzer was NOT reporting this diagnostic on base.

unsupported.claim: This change would not restore the analyzer for suppressed types.
unsupported.why: Contradicted by the fact that tests for suppressed types (e.g. MemberWithoutKeyIsReported) fail on base and pass on head.

rulings.note: Claude correctly identifies a non-regression for crashes, but is contradicted by the test results regarding the analyzer's functionality on base.
